messages:
zoe: brief: onboarding Mistral->Gemma conversion for the new 7B variant. hit a reproducible drift in attention scores after head 6 on longctx tests
ishaan: drift how severe? token misalignment or rotary phase mismatch?
zoe: both maybe. tokenizer mapping preserved but we see pattern: after ~2k tokens attention distribution collapses on certain heads
julia: could be headwise rotary params not aligned between exporter and runtime. did you check head order / proj ordering?
zoe: exporter(default) uses per-head projection ordering 'q,k,v' -> runtime expects q,v,k for some checkpoints. surprisingly only affects certain layers
miles: that's classic head-permute handshake mismatch. Also check if kv-cache layout expects contiguous head-major vs interleaved dims
ishaan: any quant involved? int8/int4 can amplify these mismatches with rescale errors
zoe: initial repro in fp16, but we experimented with int8_ptq (per-channel) and int4. quant made the collapse happen earlier in sequence
julia: please dump attention matrices for layer 10 head 6 for before/after export and a canonical input (repeat prefix x3)
zoe: done, uploaded to the CI artifact bundle under artifacts/onboard/mistral-to-gemma/1779991234/attn.npz
miles: quick triage: if head permute + kv stride mismatch then kv-cache warmup will show oscillation. try repeating a short prefix 4x and diff attention entropy over time
ishaan: also run a rotary-phase sweep. sometimes exporters bake a freq_scale or base_freq that doesn't match our runtime default and results look exactly like this
zoe: command I'm running now: ```
./convert_model --src mistral7b.ckpt --dst gemma7b.redwood --preserve-vocab --remap-head-order=auto --rotary-scale=1.0
```
zoe: changing remap-head-order=auto->strict produces a mapping file but runtime load still chooses the other layout unless we pass layout=interleaved
julia: could be the loader guessing layout by tensor shapes. Put an explicit metadata tag in the converted file and have runtime prefer it
ishaan: for quant, try per-channel symmetric with zero-point forced to 0 on projections, and store scale as float32 in metadata. avoids int4 snapbacks we've seen
miles: note: when we force rotary-scale=0.85 the longctx collapse is delayed but not fixed. suggests combined head-order + rotary scaling problem
zoe: next steps: 1) rerun convert with --remap-head-order=strict and add metadata tag layout=interleaved 2) run rotary sweep 0.7->1.1 step 0.05 3) run fp16 and int8 PTQ to compare 4) add kv-cache warmup checker to CI (repeat prefix x4)
deploy-bot: CI job triggered: onboard/mistral-gemma-handshake #482. Expect logs in ~30m
julia: also add a small eval: 10 long articles from summarization suite to compute rouge/chrF delta at 512/1024/2048
ishaan: I'll add an automated head-permute detector that compares param row-major order to expected ordering and emits a warning
zoe: filing ticket ONB-2027 with repro steps, artifacts link, and a short diff table. will follow up with results in thread
miles: if we can detect layout mismatch automatically at load time, we can avoid canary failures and fallback to float16 for hosted catalog
julia: agreed. thanks all, please tag me when the rotary sweep finishes so I can plot headwise entropy curves
zoe: will do. ping when CI completes :rocket:
